name: Photo Hunt
source: The story is happening around your character, who was unwilingly sent to his mother house. The city you have known before is now like different - so much has changed. Above all, after just one mistake you lost your siblings trust. No money, no love, only your new camera and desire to turn things upside down...
translation: 故事围绕你扮演的角色展开。他不情不愿地被送到母亲家，曾经熟悉的城市如今却像变了样，发生了太多变化。更糟的是，仅仅因为一次错误，你就失去了兄弟姐妹的信任。没有钱，没有爱，只有一台新相机，以及想要彻底扭转现状的渴望……
